description: The touchpad map of QNC (user 2026-10-18: every input device is a block with its own map). A role is what a gesture does over a panel: jog = the panel's wheel (the left/right arrow), level = Ctrl+wheel (the level of a taken A1/A2 sound), none = nothing. On Windows a two-finger swipe arrives as fine wheel steps and a pinch as Ctrl with them; on macOS a pinch is its own gesture.
